subject: PRISMBANK: Security notification — request for IRP & SOC 2 artifacts
messages:
From: Anita Suresh <anita.s@prismbank.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodai.com, ben_carter@redwoodai.com
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PRISMBANK: Suspicious connector activity — IR notification & SOC 2 evidence request

Hi Jonas —

Quick heads up from our end. At 08:50 PDT our monitoring flagged a burst of 500+ anomalous requests from the Redwood connector associated with the PrismBank test environment. We've contained the workload and rotated the affected keys on our side, but compliance wants a formal notification and a short handshake to collect SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ evidence relating to incident response and telemetry retention.

What we need from Redwood by EOD Monday (May 10):
- A copy of your Incident Response Plan (IRP) relevant to customer-facing connectors
- A brief timeline of what Redwood saw (if any) for the 08:30–09:10 window
- Telemetry extracts (sanitized) showing request ids/headers for that timeslice OR guidance on how we can request them securely
- Your SOC 2 evidence mapping for IR procedures (SIG/CAIQ pointers are fine)

I've attached the alert screenshot for context. Please confirm a secure exchange mechanism (SFTP/Drive link/secure upload) and point person for follow-ups.

Thanks,
Anita Suresh
Information Security Lead — PrismBank
Anita Suresh
Anita.s@prismbank.com

Subject: Re: PRISMBANK: Suspicious connector activity — IR notification & SOC 2 evidence request

Anita —

Thanks for the alert and the screenshot — appreciate the rapid heads-up. We're looking into our side now. High-level next steps from Redwood:
1) Marissa (security) will lead incident coordination and assemble the IR artifacts you requested.
2) We'll export a sanitized telemetry slice for 08:30–09:10 and provide request ids and request headers (no payloads).
3) We'll share a copy of the relevant IRP sections and a SOC 2 control mapping (SIG/CAIQ crosswalk).

Can you confirm the preferred upload method? We can stage artifacts to a time-limited Drive link (preferred) or SFTP. If you need an encrypted bundle, we can DocuSign an upload ACL or provide a pre-signed S3 link.

Looping in Ben for contract/NDAs if PrismBank needs an additional data processing addendum or tightened handling. Laura, please stand by for legal gating if PrismBank requests temporary elevated access.

I'll follow up with a packaged link within ~60–90 minutes unless we discover anything blocking.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Customer Security — Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: PRISMBANK: Suspicious connector activity — IR notification & SOC 2 evidence request

Anita / team —

Short update from Redwood security:
- Root cause (initial): automated test workload misconfiguration at PrismBank triggered an elevated retry pattern that looked like a spike to our anomaly detectors. No unauthorized tokens were observed on Redwood's side and there is no evidence of lateral movement.
- Containment: we rate-limited the connector and applied per-tenant throttles; no customer data was exfiltrated.
- Artifacts ready for handoff: IRP extract (sanitized), SIG control mapping, CAIQ pointers, and the telemetry slice for 08:30–09:10 with request ids.

Attached are the IRP extract and the telemetry bundle. Links below: secure Drive folder (time-limited) + DocuSign envelope for the transfer approval. Please use the Drive link; files are encrypted at rest and downloads are ACL-limited. If you need encrypted transfer instead, tell us and we'll provide an SFTP window.

Files attached: IRP_prism_redwood_v1.3.pdf, telemetry_sample_20270509.tar.gz
Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/prismbank/IRP_prism_redwood_v1.3.pdf
DocuSign (transfer approval): https://docusign.com/req/AB12C34D

If you prefer, we can also provide a small sanitized packet with specific request ids only (no header fields) to support your internal investigation — say the minimum dataset you require and we'll tailor it.

Next steps suggested:
- Prism sec to confirm receipt and which artifact set they want for compliance review (full package vs minimal IDs).
- If Prism requests raw logs, we'll ask for DPAs/ACL confirmation before providing them.

Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful — I have availability at 11:30 PT.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Security Operations — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodai.com

Marissa / Jonas —

Confirmed receipt of the Drive link and the DocuSign envelope. PrismBank's compliance team will perform an initial review of the IRP extract and the telemetry slice and will aim to provide a scope request (minimal IDs first) by COB Tuesday. We do not anticipate needing full raw logs immediately.

Please keep the Drive link active for 72 hours. We'll reach out if we need the SFTP window or a legal addendum. Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear containment notes — that helps our triage greatly.

Best,
